name: diagramos
description: Diagram-driven development: an MCP server that gives Claude read/write access to Excalidraw diagrams that live in the repo, plus a live local board.
author: Noel Matero (https://github.com/NoelMatero)

scripts.build: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:viewer && npm run build:cli
scripts.prepare: npm run build && node scripts/install-hooks.mjs && node scripts/ensure-graphify.mjs
scripts.//prepublishOnly: 0.2.0-rc.1 shipped with hooks/drift.sh still pinned to 0.1.0, so the Stop hook ran a build that had no `drift` subcommand and quietly started the MCP server instead: one line, exit 0, no check, every turn. tests/plugin-hook.test.ts catches exactly that -- it just was not run. This gate is the reason it cannot be skipped again. Builds first because packaged-board-cli serves the viewer out of the tarball, and prepublishOnly runs before prepare. e2e is left out on purpose: it needs a chromium nobody should have to install to publish.
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
